levels.title: Toosie Slide — Arena Primary
levels.blurb: Arena-dominant multi-mode arrangement: 75% Arena across four recurring motifs, with Runner, Radial and Vertical as single-section excursions at the phrase boundaries (bars 18-24, 41-48, 56-59).

levels.title: Toosie Slide — Dance Golden
levels.blurb: The whole song as one mode: 22 hand-authored Rhythm Breakout phrases, each played twice — the phrase, then its mirror at double speed — and nothing else. 44 rounds, two inputs at the start and ten at the end, with the relief sections sitting on the breakdowns. The reference chart for the dance language.

levels.title: Arkins - Jangchung — Dance
levels.blurb: The whole song as one mode: Rhythm Breakout only, bars 1-94, ending on the last musical bar before the fade. Eight sections from a fifteen-bar teaching intro through the breakdown, two drops and a peak, difficulty 1-2-3-4-2-4-5-5. Built around the track's push — accents land either on the downbeat or on beat four leaning into the next bar, and the peak is a syncopation pattern whose missing step sits exactly where the level spent eight sections teaching the player to press.

levels.title: Drip Too Hard — Dance
levels.blurb: The whole song as one mode: Rhythm Breakout only, bars 1-60, difficulty 1 through 5 and back down twice. Built around the track's swing — the phrases are triplet walks and authored silences rather than even streams, and every accent lands on the real downbeat, which the analysis puts two beats into the grid bar. Two new pattern families, seven patterns, closing on a three-round boss over the last five bars.
